title: Guided-lesson layer format v0.2 (figures layer; strictly additive over 0.1)
description: One file covers exactly one revision_note of record. 0.2 is a copy of 0.1 (draft-07, additionalProperties false throughout) with exactly three changes of record (SCHEMA-0.2-FIGURES-PROPOSAL-20261028, operator trace 1a1820011919e8b9): (1) format const bumped to guided-lesson/0.2; (2) new optional top-level figures[] — the parent revision note's own diagrams, deterministically mapped (figures-0.2-pipeline) to the lessons whose sourceHeadings anchor them; (3) new optional per-lesson figureIds[] referencing declared figure ids (closure lint-enforced both ways). Absent figures[]/figureIds[] is valid — every 0.1 artifact is a valid 0.2 artifact byte-for-byte in its authored strings. Figures carry NO new authored prose: they reuse the note's own image URLs (hotlinks already served in production) and alt text, so the canonical authored stream of the adapter spec section 7 is unchanged by construction.

figures.description: Optional figures layer (absent when the note carries no usable images — 22/112 notes). Order = note bodyMd image order; ids are note-scoped and zero-padded. moduleIds lists the lessons claiming the figure (empty = note-level figure, page-fallback only, never rendered inside the lesson flow).

id.description: Note-scoped figure id, fig-01..fig-NN in bodyMd order (observed corpus max 11 figures/note).

url.description: Machine-checkable sourcing decision of record (trace 1a1800f3b8c138e5): figures ARE the parent revision note's own asset-dir images. The pattern pins the upstream assets namespace; the mapping pipeline additionally verifies every basename resolves in the assets dir (194/194 1:1 at the grounding pin).

alt.description: Verbatim markdown alt text from the note body; when the note's own alt is empty (1 ref corpus-wide) the pipeline falls back to the asset filename slug, recorded as matchMode 'slug-fallback' in the mapping receipt.

sourceHeading.description: Nearest preceding note heading (verbatim) — provenance of the figure's position in the parent note.

moduleIds.description: Ordinals of the lessons claiming this figure via their sourceHeadings (exact match, then normalized-substring fallback). May be empty (note-level figure: readable on the note page, never inside the lesson flow — knob (b) of record).

caption.description: The parent note's own explanatory caption line — coalesced from the sidecar paragraph block immediately following the figure block (bold-italic house style), or row-context for table-embedded figures, or the introducing bullet text. Optional; absent = no explanatory line exists in the source (fail-closed).

binding.description: Which guided lesson teaches this diagram, and by which rule: heading-unique = sourceHeading listed by exactly one lesson; sole-lesson = single-lesson note; content-overlap = caption token overlap vs lesson teaching text (threshold of record: top ≥ 2 AND margin ≥ 1); note-level = moduleIds [] page-fallback; unresolved = fail-closed keep of the existing claims. Figures-2.2 binding layer; nothing authored.

noteRef.description: Corpus identity, verbatim from the revision_note row; missing values fail the lint.

specPoints.description: Codes copied from spec_point_codes of record plus the official spec text; lesson coverage across the file must equal this set.

primer.description: What-you-know-already paragraph: one paragraph, 40-80 words, citing the prerequisite by subtopic title.

lessons.description: 1-5 lessons; each maps to one or two note headings; titles reuse the note's own phrasing.

figureIds.description: Optional figures layer: ids of this lesson's claimed figures (must reference the file's declared figures[] ids; closure with figures[].moduleIds is lint-enforced both ways). Absent when the lesson claims no figures.

opening.description: 2-3 sentences, 40-90 words, plain language, no undefined term.

keyPoints.description: Each one sentence of at most 25 words, traceable to a note line or table row.

confidenceGate.description: Metadata contract of the write-once gate, not learner data.

depthLayers.description: Exactly two layers, low and medium, same section order and template: restatement, analogy, exam pointer.

check.description: Explained check items; exactly one keyed correct per item; every option explained; distractors name the misconception they catch.

misconception.description: Named misconception the distractor catches; null on the correct option; non-empty string required when correct is false (lint-enforced).

workedExample.description: Prompt, stepped solution, final answer; arithmetic lint-verified; must come from the note body where one exists; null when the note carries none (declared in the receipt).
